purpose: National-source usage audit for LoteDiretor first-wave property analysis
principles: Municipal/state parcel-scale sources take precedence over coarser national sources.
National context never upgrades absence into a negative certificate.
Authenticated registral/rural systems are not bypassed.
Municipality-level fiscal/demographic data is labeled as territorial context, never parcel attributes.
Collaborative/open data is fallback or complementary and never overrides official municipal data.

sources.name: IBGE API de Agregados / SIDRA
sources.usage: Municipal Census 2022 context: population, density, occupied permanent households, average residents per household.
sources.parcel_semantics: Municipality context only; not parcel/block/census-sector attributes.

sources.name: IBGE API de Malhas Geográficas
sources.usage: Administrative/reference boundaries available for future regional context.
sources.parcel_semantics: Not used as parcel cadastral geometry because municipal cadastral sources are more precise.

sources.name: IBGE Geoserviços Censo 2022
sources.usage: Verified official GeoServer; not yet used for automatic sector-level parcel context.
sources.parcel_semantics: Sector/demographic indicators require explicit territorial-unit matching; no silent parcel attribution.

sources.name: IBGE Base Cartográfica Contínua / BCIM-BC250
sources.usage: Regional road/hydrography/toponymy reference only.
sources.parcel_semantics: Scale 1:250,000 is unsuitable for parcel boundary, street alignment or urban-network precision; municipal layers take precedence.

sources.name: ANA / SNIRH
sources.usage: Parcel-point macro/meso/micro hydrographic region context.
sources.parcel_semantics: Hydrographic region is not flood risk.

sources.name: ICMBio / MMA
sources.usage: Federal conservation-unit intersection at parcel point plus optional map overlay.
sources.parcel_semantics: Absence of federal UC does not exclude state/municipal protection, APP or other restrictions.

sources.name: SICAR / CAR
sources.usage: Public portal verified; listed GeoServer currently exposes SNIF/CNFP layers rather than parcel CAR/APP/Reserva Legal layers.
sources.parcel_semantics: No CAR parcel inference until an official reproducible public layer or authorized connector is available.

sources.name: SGB / CPRM
sources.usage: Federal risk-sector and flood-susceptibility intersection; municipal susceptibility-map coverage metadata.
sources.parcel_semantics: Complementary to municipal risk mapping; site-specific technical confirmation remains required.

sources.name: MapBiomas
sources.usage: Official Collection 11 assets/GeoTIFFs verified for historical land-cover and urbanization context.
sources.parcel_semantics: Not in runtime yet: current server lacks managed raster dependency; avoid third-party/legacy WMS. Planned as reproducible offline/materialized raster sampling.

sources.name: INCRA Geoportal / SIGEF public layer
sources.usage: Public WFS geonode:sigef_geo parcel intersection; registry/CNS/matricula fields shown only as published SIGEF references.
sources.parcel_semantics: SIGEF certification does not replace current registry certificate, ownership or encumbrance research.

sources.name: SIGEF authenticated service
sources.usage: Not bypassed; full authenticated workflows remain outside public automatic query.
sources.parcel_semantics: Use only through legitimate authenticated/authorized flow.

sources.name: ONR / SAEC
sources.usage: Current registry certificates/matricula workflow requires legitimate authorized access.
sources.parcel_semantics: No ownership indexing or scraping.

sources.name: Sinter / Receita Federal
sources.usage: Not a public anonymous parcel API; keep as future authorized government connector.
sources.parcel_semantics: Do not imply CNM/registry linkage without authorized integration.

sources.name: FUNAI
sources.usage: Indigenous-territory polygon intersection and optional map overlay; positive connector validated on official geometry.
sources.parcel_semantics: Published administrative phase is shown as source data; legal analysis remains separate.

sources.name: Obrasgov.br
sources.usage: Public event/project connectors configured.
sources.parcel_semantics: Current public geometry contract does not provide coordinates/GeoJSON sufficient for trustworthy parcel-distance matching; no textual-address proximity inference.

sources.name: SICONFI / Tesouro Nacional
sources.usage: Municipal RREO context: IPTU/ITBI revenue and current-revenue indicators.
sources.parcel_semantics: Municipality finances are not property taxes/value of the selected parcel.

sources.name: TransfereGov
sources.usage: Municipal federal-transfer/plans context.
sources.parcel_semantics: Plan/object/value is not linked to a parcel without official geometry.

sources.name: Overpass / OpenStreetMap
sources.usage: Potential complementary pedestrian/cycling/transit/POI context; not called in every parcel report.
sources.parcel_semantics: Collaborative data quality varies; official municipal sources and OSM base map remain primary for current first-wave UI. Avoid high-volume public Overpass queries.

sources.name: DNIT / SNV
sources.usage: Nearby federal-road context with approximate geometric distance and optional map overlay.
sources.parcel_semantics: Proximity to SNV axis does not prove access, legal right-of-way width or parcel-specific federal restriction.

sources.name: BrasilAPI CEP V2
sources.usage: Same-origin CEP search fallback for the five municipalities.
sources.parcel_semantics: CEP coordinate supports navigation/search only; it is not parcel geometry.
